method.name: operator_attested_manual_Motive_world_alignment
method.description: Motive world was manually aligned to the canonical HOPE near-left table-surface corner. A stationary Ball/P1 probe independently checked the vertical convention and grounded policy-frame pelvis height.
method.limitation: The X/Y origin and axis directions rely on the onsite operator attestation below; no independent PPT or temporary reference rigid body was used.

operator_attestation.robot_support_state: operator reported the robot grounded and stable
operator_attestation.origin: (0,0,0) is the P1-side near-left corner on the table upper surface
operator_attestation.y_axis: +Y points left when facing from P1 toward P2; the working/table region is y <= 0

invalidation_conditions: Motive ground plane, world origin, Up Axis, or axis directions are changed
the calibrated camera volume is moved or recalibrated in a way that changes exported world coordinates
the table/working surface moves relative to the manually selected world origin
